page.title: Watched prices
page.intro: We re-check these prices about twice a day and tell you only when a drop is worth knowing about.
page.priceLoadFailed: We couldn’t load your hotel, activity and trip watches.
page.emptyOn: Watch a flight’s fare, a hotel, an activity or a whole saved trip from your results. We’ll keep an eye on the price and let you know when it drops or hits the price you want.
page.emptyOff: Watching flights, hotels, activities and trips needs live prices, which aren’t set up on this server yet.

empty.flight: No flights watched yet. Search a trip and choose “Watch fare” in the Flights section.
empty.hotel: No hotels watched yet. Watch a hotel from its card in your results.
empty.activity: No activities watched yet. Watch an activity from its card in your results.
empty.trip: No trips watched yet. Save a plan, then choose “Watch whole trip”.
